---
name: Accessibility or design rule
about: Propose a check the jig should run
title: 'Rule: '
labels: rule, good first issue
---

**What it detects**
One sentence. Example: "links whose only distinguishing feature is colour".

**Reference**
WCAG success criterion and level (e.g. 1.4.1 Use of Color, A), or the design principle if it isn't WCAG.

**How to fix it by hand**
The one plain sentence the report will show.

**Can auto fix it?**
If yes, what change, along which scale, and how the fix verifies itself.

**Near misses that must NOT fire**
The false positives you can think of. This is the part that makes or breaks a rule.

**Fixture**
A small HTML snippet with at least one true positive and the near misses above. See CONTRIBUTING.md, "Adding an accessibility rule".
